sections.title: # Post Graduate
content: Management Is an Art of Securing Maximum prosperity with a minimum of effort so as to secure Maximum prosperity and happiness for both the employer and employee and Give the Public the best possible service

The Two years Program of Master of Business Administration was established at TKRCET with primary objective of Developing Eminent Young Managers. MBA program is broadly designed to develop various competencies in the students in a healthy environment that motivates them. The Program Has Special emphasis on Technology Management and to meet the emerging challenges of Current Technology driven management. The Dept has Excellent Team of Experienced & Qualified Faculty. The Department has well established infrastructure and resources in the form of Library, Digital Library and References which always proved very much useful for the students.
